objectives:
本課程旨在使學生熟悉跨文化管理（Cross-Cultural Management）的各種理論觀點與實務議題。課程採用參與式學習及個案教學法，學習將以分析跨文化組織中可能出現的各類管理問題之案例為核心。學生需透過進一步的研究與探討，發展並分析各案例中的關鍵議題。

為提升學習成效並培養高階分析能力，本課程將透過課堂簡報、小組討論及個案撰寫等方式，引導學生深入理解跨文化管理的理論與實務，並強化其在全球化商業環境中的管理能力與跨文化溝通技巧。
content:
1 (9/9)	Class Introduction
2 (9/16)	Introduction: Culture
Case 1: Negotiating with Chinese Business Partners: What are you going to give us?
3 (9/23)	Oral Report 1: Hofstede’s National Culture Framework
Case 2: The Khus Project: Cultural Conflict
4 (9/30)	Oral Report 2: Edward Hall’s Framework of Context, Space, and Time
Case 3: LG Display Wroclaw: Creating a Workplace of Joy
5 (10/7)	Oral Report 3: Trompenaars and Hampden-Turner’s Societal Culture
Case 4: Rebuilding a Global Team: Tariq Khan at Tek
6 (10/14)	Oral Report 4: GLOBE Study
Case 5: East versus West: Armada India’s Ingenious Approach to HRM
7 (10/21)	Oral Report 5: Schwartz’s Cultural Orientations Framework and Values Theory
Case 6: Medical Equipment Inc. in Saudi Arabia
8 (10/28)	Oral Report 6: Cross-cultural Communication
Case 7: Office Design Partners (Thailand) Ltd.
9 (11/4)	Oral Report 7: Cross-cultural Negotiation
Case 8: Yahoo: Relationship Crisis with Alibaba in China
10 (11/11)	Sports Day (No Class)
11 (11/18)	Case 9: Leadership Crisis at Steelworks’ Xiamen Plant
12 (11/25)	Oral Report 8: Patterns of Cross-cultural Business Behaviors
Case 10: Toivonen Paper in the U.S.: Human Resource Implications of Foreign Corporate Ownership
13 (12/2)	        Case Writing Project/Cultural Exchange Event
14 (12/9)	Oral Report 9: International HR Practices and Management
Case 11:          Lundbeck Korea: Managing an International Growth Engine
15 (12/16)	Oral Report 10: South East Asian Economies and Management
Case 12: PROTON of Malaysia Rises Again: Post Cross-Border M&A Integration Between Geely and PROTON
16 (12/23)	Case Writing Project Deadline
